protocol: Three fresh processes; both versions loaded in each. Each block consumes output with Buffer.byteLength. Warmup: at least 100 ms and 5,000 short calls or 100 long calls per API/case. Eight 25 ms blocks per API in balanced Williams order. Per-process median block times and before/after ratios are retained.

source.protocol: Fresh process per variant/round; rotated order; unchanged competitor worker and 25 cases; output consumed with Buffer.byteLength; initialization excluded.
